title: Concord, one feature at a time

clips.title: Validate your data
clips.summary: Validate data checks a whole file against any release of the standard, not just the working draft.

clips.title: Describe a use case
clips.summary: Anyone can describe how they'd use the standard, in a short interview.

clips.title: Reports from coding agents
clips.summary: Coding agents connected to Concord report the gaps they find in the standard.

clips.title: Voting on a breaking change
clips.summary: When its comment period ends, a breaking change goes to a vote of the working group.

clips.title: Setting the rules
clips.summary: Each standard sets its own rules for deciding changes, and anyone can read them.
